rows.label: qst310101_msg0001
rows.name:
Rex! Have you got the hang of
how Merc Groups work?

rows.label: qst310101_msg0002
rows.name: More or less.

rows.label: qst310101_msg0003
rows.name: Oh! Then this'll be easy to explain.

rows.label: qst310101_msg0004
rows.name: Hm?

rows.label: qst310101_msg0005
rows.name:
I should tell you about
Merc Group Action too, Rex.

rows.label: qst310101_msg0006
rows.name: Merc Group Action?

rows.label: qst310101_msg0007
rows.name:
That's right! Merc Groups send
Blades on assignments, but[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst310101_msg0008
rows.name:
In Merc Group Action, you command
Blades to carry out assignments.

rows.label: qst310101_msg0009
rows.name:
You get to experience the work
of a Merc Group firsthand[ML:Dash ]
That might be clearer.

rows.label: qst310101_msg0010
rows.name:
Hmm... I think I get it[ML:Dash ]
Or maybe I don't[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst310101_msg0011
rows.name:
Blades gain experience, and you
get the same rewards, too.

rows.label: qst310101_msg0012
rows.name:
Well, better to try it yourself!
You get to enjoy a different
kind of battle, too.

rows.label: qst310101_msg0013
rows.name:
So let's take on a Merc Group
Action assignment right away!

rows.label: qst310101_msg0014
rows.name: What?! Already?!

rows.label: qst310101_msg0015
rows.name:
You'll be fine!
I know you can do it, Rex.

rows.label: qst310101_msg0016
rows.name: And what makes you so sure[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst310101_msg0017
rows.name:
The boss gave you his approval[ML:Dash ]
Isn't that reason enough?

rows.label: qst310101_msg0018
rows.name: [ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst310101_msg0019
rows.name:
All right[ML:Dash ]
I'll do it, okay?!

rows.label: qst310101_msg0020
rows.name: That's the spirit!

rows.label: qst310101_msg0021
rows.name:
If you get stuck on an assignment,
check Vandham's Guidebook.
That should sort it out.

rows.label: qst310101_msg0022
rows.name:
Once you've finished,
come talk to me again!
